name: steam-bpm
description: Steam Big Picture image (quasar-steam family): cold home, sign-in screen, gamepad-first UI.

oracle.label: bpm-signin
oracle.expect: account + password fields, QR sign-in panel, live clock, Xbox glyph footer
oracle.rules_out: a "Waiting for network" stall from the system-bus / NetworkManager init hook

require_logs: shutdown requested; relaying to launched processes

notes: Steam is signed out under QA (the harness holds no credentials), so Steam never prints its own "Shutdown" line — gate 5's evidence is the launcher's SIGTERM relay plus exit 143. Signed-in shutdown is out of scope.
